rows.en: Defend La Vie en Rose
rows.speaker: HUD

rows.en: Defeat enemy forces
rows.speaker: HUD

rows.en: Escort target destroyed
rows.speaker: HUD

rows.en: Defeat the Risnir
rows.speaker: HUD

rows.en: We have received a request for support from Commander Misumaru of the United Space Force.
rows.speaker: Bright Noa?

rows.en: The UCE Space Force ignored the call for support. I guess they've got bigger problems...
rows.speaker: Bright Noa?

rows.en: Our priority is to keep our allies safe. We will now <mk(0,50,0,0)><ar(0,0,0,50)>move out to rescue them.
rows.speaker: Bright Noa?

rows.en: It's been a while, people of the Ra Cailum. I thank you for your cooperation.
rows.speaker: Kouichirou Misumaru?

rows.en: Here on La Vie en Rose, enhanced machines using E2 were being mass-produced.
rows.speaker: Kouichirou Misumaru?

rows.en: By producing machines that fuse E2 with Mobile Doll technology, Dermail
rows.speaker: Kouichirou Misumaru?

rows.en: is trying to build an invincible army. And the reason they have begun their offensive now
rows.speaker: Kouichirou Misumaru?

rows.en: is that the prototypes are done and they have the power to overwhelm all other factions.
rows.speaker: Kouichirou Misumaru?

rows.en: The UCE Space Force is now heading for Sweetwater, together with the Enhanced Corps.
rows.speaker: Kouichirou Misumaru?

rows.en: As an example to the colonies that declared they would stop supplying resources to Earth,
rows.speaker: Kouichirou Misumaru?

rows.en: they intend to crush Sweetwater, where Kahns, the leader of the colonies, is.
rows.speaker: Kouichirou Misumaru?

rows.en: Even innocent civilians are about to be dragged into this...
rows.speaker: Kouichirou Misumaru?

rows.en: The UCE is now merely Dermail's private property. But we won't simply overlook that.
rows.speaker: Kouichirou Misumaru?

rows.en: The United Space Force intends to do everything in its power to stop him.
rows.speaker: Kouichirou Misumaru?

rows.en: I won't force you to act. I want you to judge the right path for yourselves.
rows.speaker: Kouichirou Misumaru?

rows.en: I had heard of your exploits, so I find this outcome truly regrettable.
rows.speaker: Kouichirou Misumaru?
